changelog: **Redundant entry (WCAG 3.3.7, #2864):** `POST /api/invite/opened` returns the invitation's address for a live invitation of this world, and the register form pre-fills it (still editable; a dead, unknown or other-world token answers `{ ok: true }` as before). The offer wizard carries a chosen requisition's title into an empty Position. VPAT 3.3.7 now reads `Supports` after an audit of registration, onboarding, the offer wizard and account settings.

en: Signing up from an invitation no longer asks for your email address again, and offers take the position from the chosen requisition.
tr: Davetle kayıt olurken e-posta adresiniz tekrar sorulmuyor; teklifler pozisyonu seçilen iş talebinden alıyor.
de: Bei der Registrierung über eine Einladung wird die E-Mail-Adresse nicht mehr erneut abgefragt, und Angebote übernehmen die Position aus der gewählten Stellenanforderung.
